data.name: RoveSoSimulator
data.detailed_description:
World Champion URC 2025 Rover

RoveSoSimulator is the official simulator used by the Missouri S&T Mars Rover Design Team to test and refine their URC 2025 world‑champion Mars Rover. Pilot the same competition-grade rover and experience URC-inspired navigation, obstacle, and manipulation challenges just like the team.


About the Game

RoveSoSimulator is a custom-built rover simulator created by the Mars Rover Design Team at Missouri S&T to test and refine their real-world prototype Mars Rover. Developed as an engineering tool rather than a traditional game, it models the same systems and constraints the team faces when competing at the University Rover Challenge, where they brought home the world title from URC 2025.

Inside RoveSoSimulator, you drive a competition-grade Mars Rover through realistic challenge scenarios inspired by URC tasks: autonomous navigation, obstacle fields, and precise manipulation. Whether you are an aspiring robotics engineer, a space enthusiast, or a fan of the Missouri S&T Mars Rover Design Team, RoveSoSimulator offers a unique window into the engineering behind a world‑champion Mars rover.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: Core i7-6700 or Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD/HD Graphics or AMD Radeon Graphics
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 11
  • Processor: Core i7-6700 or Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 3 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 1060 6GB or Radeon RX 580 8GB or Arc A380. Vram: 6 GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
